title: Implement ingestion queue with configurable depth
description:
Buffer incoming articles in an async channel before the store-and-forward pipeline. Configurable queue depth (default 1000). When queue is full, respond to the peer with 431 and stop reading until queue drains below 80% capacity. Expose queue_depth_current and queue_depth_max as Prometheus gauges. Artifact: transit/src/peering/ingestion_queue.rs.

Acceptance: queue depth enforced; 431 response when full; metrics exposed; no article lost when queue drains; test: fill queue, verify 431 responses, drain queue, verify resumption
